summary: @servicetitan/admin-layout preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks the binary executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped inside the tarball. setup.mjs itself uses hex-mangled identifiers and wrapper aliases that obscure this flow. The executed `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated blob (runtime string-array rotation function `WV8StW`, large numeric constant table `n7gIxM`, single-char/hex-mangled identifiers) with no readable strings, no documented purpose, and no relation to a React admin-layout UI package. Fetching an alternate JS runtime at npm install to execute an obfuscated bundled payload is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern: the code runs with full user privileges on the installer's host on every `npm install`, outside the Node process that most tooling monitors, and its behavior cannot be determined from the shipped source.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
